author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
SaaS companies who try to make short term profit by setup tollbooth for AI agents will lose all their customers in the long term.

DON'T be tempted to sell tokens with a markup, don't block me use my AI agents.  SaaS should compete on cost efficiency. If your AI agent is cheaper than running my own AI agent, I am happy to use yours.

ChatGPT Pro Deep Research report, I asked the question, burnt the tokens,  share the report with everyone.

shared_article.title: The SaaS Agent Tollbooth vs. the Open Agent Platform
